BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Before
you begin.

Do I need gym experience?+

No. The Lotus approach begins with your starting point. Class levels and instructor guidance will be confirmed when the studio programme launches.

What should I bring?+

Comfortable movement clothes, supportive training shoes, a towel and water are a good starting point. Session-specific guidance will accompany bookings.

Can I book a session now?+

Bookings are not open yet. The studio location, timetable and prices will be announced on our contact page.
